bnf.description: French editions from the Bibliothèque nationale de France catalogue as a metadata source: series, albums, ISBNs, publishers, release dates and credits, no account needed

bnf.label: Bibliothèque nationale de France (French editions)
bnf.note: Looks series and albums up in the national catalogue, which lists nearly every book published in France. Best for French-language albums and translations: numbering, ISBNs, publishers, release dates and credits are complete, but there are no character lists or story arcs, summaries are rare, and a cover is only shown for albums the catalogue holds one for. No account is needed; Discover needs the built-in service or ComicVine.
